## Hermes digest – calories-report
22:00 Europe/Athens → Talk room of profile calories.

One stateless JSON-RPC call to the wger MCP server (tools/call nutrition_summary for today). Totals plus the logged items. Template only, no LLM. Nothing logged today = no message.

Manual run = dry run: the result is returned, nothing is posted. Another workflow can call this one with {"dry_run": false|true, "use_llm": false, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. The workflow is its own error workflow: a failed scheduled run posts one line to the room. Credentials are created by n8n/scripts/hermes-digests-setup.sh.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method: 'tools/call', params: { name: 'nutrition_summary', arguments: { when: $('Run options').first().json.today } } }) }}
